description: This file defines a React hook 'useMcpOAuthFlow' that manages the OAuth authorization flow with MCP servers, including generating code challenges, managing OAuth state in session storage, initiating authorization requests, and handling OAuth callbacks and token exchange.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes an ArrayBuffer into a URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: generateCodeVerifier
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure code verifier string for PKCE flow.

methods.name: generateCodeChallenge
methods.description: Generates a code challenge from a code verifier using SHA-256 and base64 URL-safe encoding.
